name: spomky-labs/pwa-bundle
description: Progressive Web App Manifest Generator Bundle for Symfony.

suggest.symfony/mime: For generating and manipulating icons or screenshots
suggest.symfony/filesystem: For generating and manipulating icons or screenshots
suggest.symfony/panther: For generating screenshots directly from your application

scripts.ecs: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 ecs check --config .ci-tools/ecs.php
scripts.ecs:fix: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 ecs check --config .ci-tools/ecs.php --fix
scripts.rector: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 rector process --dry-run --config .ci-tools/rector.php
scripts.rector:fix: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 rector process --config .ci-tools/rector.php
scripts.phpstan: docker run --init -it --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -v "$PWD/tmp-phpqa:/tmp" -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 phpstan analyse --configuration=.ci-tools/phpstan.neon
scripts.phpstan:baseline: docker run --init -it --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -v "$PWD/tmp-phpqa:/tmp" -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 phpstan analyse --configuration=.ci-tools/phpstan.neon --generate-baseline=.ci-tools/phpstan-baseline.neon
scripts.lint: docker run --init -it --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -v "$PWD/tmp-phpqa:/tmp" -w /project ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 composer exec -- parallel-lint src tests
scripts.infect: docker run --init -it --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -u)" --pull always -v "$PWD":/project -v "$PWD/tmp-phpqa:/tmp" -w /project -e XDEBUG_MODE=coverage ghcr.io/spomky-labs/phpqa:8.4 infection --min-msi=35 --min-covered-msi=80 --threads=max --logger-github -s --filter=src/ --configuration=.ci-tools/infection.json.dist
